subject: economics
objective: What compound growth rate does this series imply?
instruction: The Westvale economics ministry asks for several measures: Real output was USD 560,000,000 at the start and USD 812,000,000 at the end of a span of 6 year(s), while the population went from 3,200,000 to 3,560,000. Use compound (geometric) annual rates: g = (end / start)^(1/periods) - 1, applied separately to output, to population and to output per person. Periods are years. Required: total growth rate, average annual growth rate, population growth rate, per capita annual growth rate, years to double.
